(Photo by Erik McGregor/LightRocket via Getty Images) The Brief April 5 marks Easter Sunday this year.Here is a list of what is open or closed on Easter Sunday. Easter Sunday is this weekend and many stores across the country will be closed or varying their hours to observe the Christian holiday. It’s recommended that you call your local store to verify hours. Aldi: Closed Costco: Closed CVS: OpenGopuff: OpenKohl’s: Closed Kroger: Open This includes Baker’s, City Market, Dillons, Food 4 Less, Foods Co, Fred Meyer, Fry’s, Gerbes, Jay C Food STore, King Soopers, Mariano’s, Metro Market, Pay-Less Super Markets, Pick ‘n Save, QFC, Ralphs, Ruler and Smith’s Food and Drug.
